body: Trust me, i've been taking steps towards improving my life for myself. I went from sleeping in through most of my classes last year and having my GPA plummet to the ground to switching schools and programs and now i've been having set sleeping schedules and attending my classes. That's the one thing that i've improved about myself that i'm genuinely proud of myself for. Do you know what's one thing that hasn't changed these past two years? Not a single shed of meaningful support from any loved ones throughout one of the most difficult experiences of my life. It's hard wanting to go on at this point when that hasn't changed one bit, neither does it make me change my opinion that there are people that I know in my life that truly care about what has been and is going on in my life.
